hints.title: Winning Position State
hints.text: Let winning state be defined as true if the player who faces that stone count can force a win.

hints.title: Forcing Opponent Loss
hints.text: From pile size i, if there is any square k * k <= i such that i - k * k is a losing position for the opponent, then i is a winning position.

hints.title: Base Case and Iteration
hints.text: With 0 stones, current player loses (false). Fill up table from 1 to n.
